tool_args.rationale: The mobility-bridge and flux-conservation signatures suggest a coupled transfer mechanism, but seven observations at one horizon and one initial state leave its dynamics underidentified. A fine trajectory batch can distinguish candidate time-dependent laws before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot and branch observations constrain the response to u_now and s_grad, but all share the same horizon and x_now; they do not identify the transfer dynamics or their dependence on state.
The acquired branch observations already establish a substantial gradient dependence; trajectory variation is more useful for distinguishing dynamic mechanisms.
It does not address the remaining mechanism-identification ambiguity.
